book.title: Cama Tsǝtsǝfǝ Nǝ Bulusu Anǝ Njir Afisa

content: Thlǝr Nǝ Bulusu Anǝ Njira Aˈyi Njir Yahudiya Mai
Agabangau, nayi Bulusu, nayi ndǝra nji fuwa wu fursǝna ara nu Kǝrsiti Yesu arya hyi, nahyi njira aˈyi njir Yahudiya mai.
A hǝnggǝr yau, abǝr a nggar hyi ǝnggǝra Hyal wu lagu mayiwakur nyi nǝ ɗa thlǝr kau nǝ dlǝwar hyi.
Najakǝ ngǝ sǝ ɗǝɗǝwa kǝra canǝ ɗa kǝr lagur mǝtakǝr, ǝnggǝr kǝra yi tsǝfǝri anǝ hyi ndǝr yiɗawu.
Ma ga jiganari, gu nggabiya sǝra yi sǝni, sǝra aˈyi ɗǝɗǝwa ar kǝra Kǝrsiti,
kǝra aˈyi canǝ nyi kǝr anǝ njir zaman zaman kǝra tǝrabiya kǝ mai, ǝnggǝr kǝra ji canǝ nyi kǝr lagu Mambǝl Hyal anǝ cama sǝsǝ nyiˈyar ǝnga nabi nyiˈyar kǝra cicau.

Najaka sǝ ɗǝɗǝwa ca ngǝ, abǝr, lagur ndǝshigu kǝ ngǝ njira aˈyi njir Yahudiya mai wu uya sǝr faˈa ki ǝnga njir Yahudiya, ǝnga a ɗar nda nji zǝmǝ wu daɓǝ dzau, ba ǝnga ndu sa sǝm alkawal dadaɓǝ kǝra Hyal mǝliya wu Kǝrsiti Yesu.
Yi ɗa mafa nǝ ndǝshigu kau, lagur mayiwakur nǝ Hyal kǝra yi dlǝwuri lagur mǝl thlǝr dǝnama nyi.

Alaga kǝ nayi nga ndiya ǝnga kushu wu pama patǝr nji cici nǝ Hyal, nji nǝ ɗa najaka mayiwakur aga ya tǝtǝlna ndǝshigu anǝ njira aˈyi njir Yahudiya mai. Ndǝshigu kau, ca ngǝ barka ɗǝɗǝwa kǝra nji gǝra sǝn walbiya wu Kǝrsiti.
Nayi tsu ya cabiya anǝ kalar nji ar babal lagu kǝra ji pabǝri nǝ mǝl sǝ ɗǝɗǝwa nyi, sǝ kǝra Hyal ɗǝwana wu kǝrnyi fa gangǝ kǝra tǝrabiya kau, ndǝra naja ngǝ mǝliya kalar sau.
Dǝnga nyi ǝnga najaka mayiwakur ca ngǝ, lagur daɓǝ dzǝ njir nu, nji a cabiya gangǝkura hahangǝkur nǝ Hyal anǝ mambǝl mambǝl kǝra a vǝr sǝm tǝlkur ǝnga dǝnama dǝnama tǝlkurˈyar kǝra a dǝmǝlmau.
Kǝ ɗarkǝr ǝnggǝr kǝra Hyal mbiya tsu kaɗǝu, kǝra ji nyabiya wu Kǝrsiti Yesu Thlagǝr mǝn.
Wu ja ǝnga lagur mbǝrsa wu ja nga mǝnu sǝni shili ǝgya Hyal ǝnga ɗǝfu zǝmǝu ba gǝra hivǝr.
Agabangau, yu kǝdi hyi, a sara dza hya tǝ arya ɓwaɓwatǝ kǝra yi a gwa arya hyi mai, naja ngǝ kadakadarkur hyi.
Kǝdi Hyal Nǝ Bulusu Arya Njir Afisa
Arya kau, yu ɓǝliya undi wu mwar Dǝrmǝn,
naja ndǝra patǝr njira a dǝmǝlmau ǝnga njira wu duniya biya sara wu ja.
Ya vǝr kǝdi nyi, abǝr sara wu gangǝkur kadakadarkur nyi aga ja nyabiya hyi ǝnga dǝnama wu ɗǝfuwa hyi lagu Mambǝl nyi,
aga Kǝrsiti a nggya wu ɗǝfuwa hyi lagur mbǝrsa. Ba ǝnga yu kǝdiyau, aga hya ciya hi wu yiwudzau,
aga hya uya dǝnama daɓǝ ǝnga patǝr nji cici gǝ Hyal, aga hya nggabiya culi dlaɓǝkura yiwukur nǝ Kǝrsiti, ǝnga tǝgukura nyi, ǝnga dzǝgamǝkura nyi a gya, ba ǝnga dzǝgamǝkura nyi a dǝ.
Ənga tsu yu ɓǝra kǝdi Hyal aga hya sǝn yiwukur nǝ Kǝrsiti kǝra tǝrabiya a biya banga patǝr sǝn sau, aga hya nyabiya dzau wu nyinyikur nǝ Hyal.
Kadakadarkur a nggyari anǝ Hyalǝr mǝn, ndǝra dǝnama nyi a vǝr mǝl thlǝr wu mǝn a ndiya sǝra mǝn wu kǝdiyau, ǝnga sǝra mǝn wu ɗǝnga.
Kadakadarkur a nggyari anǝ nyi wu daɓǝ dzǝ njir nu ǝnga wu Kǝrsiti Yesu, wu zaman pamǝpamǝ patǝu, baˈanuwa! Amina.
